adapter_resolution: The separate adapter writes exactly two Windows records, two Ubuntu records, and two joined pair seals, requires synchronized files and containing directories for all six writes, then launches fresh read-only Windows and Ubuntu verifiers with an exact expected cardinality of two and an exact six-file allowlist.

collector_conclusion.reason: The collector deliberately enforces exact zero-based whole-store names and cardinality. Its published 20-pair qualification, copied-byte digest verification, and unchanged Windows and Ubuntu unit suites pass. The public blocker is reproduced only by supplying the wrong orchestration scope to that valid guard.

limitations: Only fixed harmless public strings and trivial exits were used.
No diagnostic case, input, corpus, seed, candidate, or retained diagnostic stream was accessed or produced.
This package qualifies infrastructure only and grants no diagnostic execution authority.
public_safe_root_cause: The collector verifier's count parameter is whole-store cardinality, not the cardinality of the newest pair. A pair-local orchestration reused one growing store, successfully verified the first one-row state with count one, appended the second platform rows, and invoked the fresh verifier with count one again. The immutable collector correctly rejected the now-extra row before a second pair seal could be committed.
scope: Public synthetic infrastructure qualification only; no diagnostic execution or Ferris source inspection
